name: Seduce Me: A Lesson In Romance
source:
"I Still Have A Lot To Learn About You."

James and I learn about each other each and every day that passes between us. It's an interesting experience, to say the least.

Just how much does James know, though?

[From [url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/seduce-me-the-otome-episode-series]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我对你还有很多需要了解。”

詹姆斯和我一天天相处，逐渐了解彼此。这至少是一次有趣的经历。

不过，詹姆斯到底了解多少？
